column1: # Babi's audience, part I: Colosso's reward, the audience, and the first revelations about Lemuria.

column3: I've waited for you.\nThere is something we\nmust discuss.{end_wait}
It's difficult to speak\nacross the room.\nCome closer.{end_wait}
The contests at Colosso\nwere worth witnessing.{end_wait}
It was a fine sight to\nsee Babi's chosen warrior\ncarry the day.{end_wait}
Iodem, present the\nvictor's reward.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} received\n{argument_item_name:2}.{end_wait}
Now, {actor_name:1}, have you\nrecovered from the\ntrials?{end_now}
It pleased me to see\nBabi's chosen warrior\nstand until the end.{end_wait}
Tell me, {actor_name:1}, are\nyou feeling well again?{end_now}
Youth restores itself\nquickly, even after\nsuch trials.{end_wait}
You must be exhausted.\nI can hardly believe\nyou're standing.{end_wait}
Who could expect less\nfrom those who brought\nBabi safely home?{end_wait}
Enough praise. Why have\nyou summoned us?{end_wait}
Watch your tongue!\nDo you know who you\nare addressing?{end_wait}
Let him speak, Iodem.\nThere are better ways\nto judge a man.{end_wait}
What did you say\nyour name was?{end_wait}
He is speaking to\nyou, {actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
Yes, {actor_name:2}. We will\nexplain the matter.{end_wait}
We owe you and your\ncompanions for bringing\nme back, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
But a simple expression\nof gratitude will not\nsettle everything...{end_wait}
I have already told\nIodem the whole story.{end_wait}
What do you mean by\nthe whole story?{end_wait}
You wish to learn more\nabout Lemuria, don't you?{end_now}
Indeed. Your curiosity\nis plain to see.{end_wait}
There is no need to hide\nit. I can read the question\non your faces.{end_wait}
I have only just seen\nPsynergy for myself.\nWhat a power...{end_wait}
I used the Cloak Ball\nto let him witness\nPsynergy firsthand.{end_wait}
The others saw nothing,\nbut I knew {actor_name:1}'s\ncontest was unusual.{end_wait}
I doubted you would\nuse such power in a\nfight...{end_wait}
Do not be ashamed,\n{actor_name:1}. Psynergy is\nalso a warrior's gift.{end_wait}
When I first learned\nwhat you could do, I\nthought you were Lemurians.{page_break}I was astonished.{end_wait}
You speak of Lemuria\noften, Babi. What is it?{end_wait}
A city of an ancient\npeople, hidden far out\nat sea.{end_wait}
Babi traveled there\naround the time of\nthe great flood.{end_wait}
The flood came while\nI was traveling with\nLunpa.{end_wait}
Lunpa? The thief\nfrom the old stories?{end_wait}
I know it sounds\nimpossible. It was\nmore than a century ago.{end_wait}
Then the rumors about\nyou were true?{end_wait}
Kraden spoke of the\nStone of Sages. Could\nthat explain your age?{end_now}
The Stone that grants\nimmortality came from\nLemuria?{end_wait}
Don't tell me you've\nforgotten the Stone\nof Sages...{end_now}
